label: Alternate: 2011 data, thesis method, biodiesel yield corrected
description: An alternate to 2011-corrected: the 2011 data and zones with the method module biodiesel-yield. It shows what the thesis's long-term result would have been with the oilseed yield counted once. The long term changes by far the most (the short term only through its 0.23% biofuel share).
